title: Ailing, homeless family found beside Bayugan creek needs help
summary: SAN FRANCISCO, Agusan del Sur — A kagawad (councilor) of Barangay Taglatawan in Bayugan City, Agusan del Sur has extended initial financial assistance and vowed to coordinate further rescue efforts…

blocks.text: SAN FRANCISCO, Agusan del Sur — A kagawad (councilor) of Barangay Taglatawan in Bayugan City, Agusan del Sur has extended initial financial assistance and vowed to coordinate further rescue efforts for an ailing, homeless family—including a pregnant mother—who has been living beside a creek after leaving their mountain village in search of work.
